steps.caption: Open More → Imports (Capture's 'Upload a spreadsheet' goes to the same place).
Upload: choose files, an as-of date and the source. Formulas and macros are never run.
Choose 'Pune contacts.xlsx' — companies, contacts, areas, locations and lease expiries.
Version 1, its fingerprint and the detected kind: Contacts & requirements.
Three steps: 1 already added (companies you had, new people), 2 needs your OK, 3 could not be imported.
Safe rows can be added in one click by an owner or admin. The rest you decide yourself.
Column mapping: each column with the field it was matched to, and how sure CRE OS is.
'Area Reqd → Required Area 65%' is a guess to confirm. Unmatched columns are kept as custom values.
Remarks was mapped to Notes. To keep it as its own column, open 'Correct this mapping'.
Column I, Remarks: choose 'Keep as custom'.
Approve mapping and re-process. It is remembered for this layout and future files.
The mapping card now uses your approved mapping.
Validation report: rows checked, blocking findings, findings to review and notes.
Open 'Invalid email addresses': cell D3 has a double @ — kept raw, never saved as a contact method.
Invalid phone, an area without a unit (not assumed to be sq ft) and a date that could be 4 May or 5 April.
Notes: area basis not stated, dates without a day — kept unknown, not invented.
Rows with a problem: each finding with its cell and the reason.
New people from this file are only proposed — Rahul Khanna has no valid email or phone.
